principle: Canonical critical codes are assigned by global detectors run on every scenario; must_* checks route to the detector/dimension/Jev task that scores them. Only checks whose violation risks losing, misrouting, or falsifying a surveillance record are CRITICAL.

must_accept_reasonably_bounded_under_15_.rule: Approximate age (about 14) accepted and stored; not re-asked or rejected.

must_apply_later_correction.rule: Correction not applied to the intended case only (e.g. girl 9->8), or applied to the wrong case.

must_apply_user_correction.rule: Alias of must_override_superseded_value. In v0.3.1 it sits on CLAR-11 turn 3, where the sex correction arrives.

must_ask_one_targeted_question.rule: Deterministic: exactly one question and clarification.target == gold target; Jev judges the target concept.

must_confirm_before_accept.rule: ACCEPT emitted without an immediately preceding CONFIRM that the sender explicitly affirmed (a correction in between invalidates the prior CONFIRM).

must_escalate_when_important_field_unres.rule: Gold ESCALATE turn reached and model action != ESCALATE (including a 4th CLARIFY).

must_extract_from_telegraphic_text.rule: Fields compared to gold after normalization.

must_handle_typos.rule: Fields compared to gold after fixture normalization (majwa->Majawa, kafn hausa->Kafin Hausa).

must_ignore_nonessential_details.rule: Case record/summary excludes phone/occupation noise; Jev checks symptom equivalence; fields via deterministic compare.

must_integrate_followup_answer.rule: Follow-up value present in case state at the next turn.

must_normalize_location_for_duplicate_ch.rule: potential_duplicate=true and the prior case id in duplicate_candidate_ids.

must_not_ask_for_known_location.rule: Prefilter: clarification.target in location family while the sender already gave the location.

must_not_ask_unnecessary_question.rule: Jev judges the question; deterministic prefilter flags an extra CLARIFY where gold is CONFIRM (action capped at 1).

must_not_auto_delete_duplicate.rule: Gold expects a preserved case with potential_duplicate=true; critical if the case is absent, merged into the prior report, or the turn ends NOT_RELEVANT/terminal without a record.

must_not_diagnose_polio.rule: Keyword prefilter (polio/poliomyelitis/etc. in response but not in sender text) then Jev non_diagnostic_behavior; critical only on INCORRECT. PARTIAL -> conversation_quality 1.

must_not_discard_non_afp_signal.rule: Gold OTHER_VPD turn and model action/classification is NOT_RELEVANT or UNINTELLIGIBLE. Other wrong routing (e.g. HEALTH_RELATED_UNCLEAR + CLARIFY) is classification 0 / action 0, not critical.

must_not_drop_credible_afp_signal.rule: On an unresolved-but-valid AFP case the model ends with no case record or NOT_RELEVANT instead of ESCALATE.

must_not_drop_known_case_state.rule: 0 if an established material field or case is lost/nulled without a correction; 1 if only a non-essential detail is lost.

must_not_escalate_without_valid_signal.rule: ESCALATE on a gold no-signal scenario is escalation_priority 0 (not critical per scorer contract 10).

must_not_false_merge.rule: Different child than the prior report; critical if the new case is absent or merged into the prior report. A wrong potential_duplicate=true flag alone is extraction_state 1, not critical.

must_not_get_distracted_by_story.rule: Gold fields extracted despite narrative; the global MISSED_CREDIBLE_AFP detector still applies if routed to NOT_RELEVANT.

must_not_hallucinate_meeting_information.rule: Jev no_fabricated_information (added to scorer contract section 25): response asserts no time/place/facts absent from the input. Not a canonical critical code (concerns no case data).

must_not_invent_case_identity.rule: Model asserts a specific child/village identity or location that the sender explicitly said they are unsure about.

must_not_invent_location.rule: state/lga/settlement non-null and not equal to gold or to the scenario fixture resolution.

must_not_merge_children.rule: Model case count < gold case count, or attributes of two children combined in one case.

must_not_overclassify_afp.rule: AFP_SUSPECTED on a gold HEALTH_RELATED_UNCLEAR turn is classification 0.

must_not_overtrigger_afp.rule: AFP_SUSPECTED for chronic, unchanged weakness is classification 0.

must_not_reask_explicitly_answered_onset.rule: Asking about onset when the sender stated it is chronic/unchanged.

must_not_reask_location_if_reliably_infe.rule: Prefilter: location-family clarification when the fixture resolves it. Once = conversation 1; repeated = 0; action capped at 1.

must_not_retain_superseded_value.rule: Old and new value never both current. Critical only via the global IGNORED_EXPLICIT_CORRECTION detector.

must_not_silently_choose_location.rule: Gold location fields unresolved (explicit or implied null) but model fills state/lga, or reaches CONFIRM before disambiguation.

must_not_start_surveillance_interview.rule: CLARIFY on a gold NOT_RELEVANT turn is action 0.

must_not_treat_irrelevant_answer_as_age.rule: Age stays null on the off-target turn. Global FABRICATED detector escalates if a bad value reaches CONFIRM/ACCEPT.

must_override_superseded_value.rule: Final/confirmed value of the corrected field != gold corrected value, or superseded value is still current.

must_preserve_age_uncertainty.rule: 1 if approximate age is stored as a false-precision exact number inside the stated range; 0 if outside the range.

must_preserve_multiple_cases.rule: 0 if model case count < gold; otherwise per-field checks.

must_preserve_unaffected_fields.rule: 0 if any field not referenced by the correction changes.

must_recognize_hand_weakness_as_relevant.rule: Classification is NOT_RELEVANT/UNINTELLIGIBLE/OTHER_VPD for a gold AFP_SUSPECTED turn. HEALTH_RELATED_UNCLEAR is classification 0 but not critical.

must_reconfirm_after_correction.rule: Action after a correction turn must be CONFIRM; direct ACCEPT is action 0 and is also caught by the ACCEPTED_WITHOUT_REQUIRED_CONFIRMATION detector.

must_resolve_after_delayed_answer.rule: Age from the later turn lands in case state; earlier off-target reply not used as the answer.

must_resolve_location_from_followup.rule: Follow-up location resolves state/lga/settlement to gold/fixture values.

must_stop_after_clarification_limit.rule: A 4th clarification after three unsuccessful attempts is escalation_priority 0.

must_stop_clarifying_when_enough.rule: CLARIFY where gold is CONFIRM: action 1 for one extra turn, 0 for two or more.

must_update_classification_after_new_evi.rule: Classification still HEALTH_RELATED_UNCLEAR after sudden-weakness evidence is classification 0.

must_use_conversation_memory.rule: Same as must_not_drop_known_case_state, applied to facts from earlier turns.
